config.Use_Waterfall_Cave_WaFFLE.name: Activate the Waterfall Cave
config.Use_Waterfall_Cave_WaFFLE.descrip: Make the Waterfall Cave accessible on your farm (this will be in addition to the normal cave). Disabling this option will remove all of the cave extra entrances from the map.
config.Cave_Foliage_WaFFLE.name: Cave foliage color
config.Cave_Foliage_WaFFLE.description: Select the cave foliage color (On top of it, all foliage can be turned green using AToMS config menu).
config.Stone_Cave_WaFFLE.name: Remove cave soil
config.Stone_Cave_WaFFLE.description: Remove the dirt patches from the Waterfall Cave, leaving only a natural stone floor.
config.Remove_Cave_Obstacles_WaFFLE.name: Remove cave obstacles
config.Remove_Cave_Obstacles_WaFFLE.desc: Remove the bushes and the wall east of the river from the Waterfall Cave.
config.Cellar_Allows_Casks_in_Cave_WaFFL: Once the farmhouse cellar is built, extend the usage of casks to the Waterfall Cave.
config.Secret_Woods_Shortcut_WaFFLE.name: Shortcut to Secret Woods
config.Secret_Woods_Shortcut_WaFFLE.desc: Unlock a path next to the farm's shrine that will quickly lead to the Secret Woods if the player has already been there at least once.
config.Use_Animal_Pen_WaFFLE.name: Add Animal pens
config.Use_Animal_Pen_WaFFLE.description: Place one or more animal pens on the western side of the farm.
config.Animal_Pen_Size_WaFFLE.name: Animal pens number & size
config.Animal_Pen_Size_WaFFLE.descriptio: Select the amount and size of the animal pens.
config.Use_Invisible_Barriers_WaFFLE.des: Prevent animals from leaving the pen. Disable to let them roam the farm freely.
config.Beach_Type_WaFFLE.name: Beach type
config.Beach_Type_WaFFLE.description: Choose between a saltwater beach with sea forage, fishes & palm trees, a grassy beach with a large lake, a dry beach with more land & a pond or a dead beach full of sand with dead trees and no fishes.
config.Beach_Fish_WaFFLE.name: Beach fishes
config.Beach_Fish_WaFFLE.description: Choose what kind of fishes can be caught on the beach (with the exception of the desolate one).
config.Beach_Coral_WaFFLE.name: Coral reef
config.Beach_Coral_WaFFLE.description: SEA BEACH ONLY! Determinate the size of the coral reef, by default only around the small islands but can either be entirely removed or cover the entire sea floor.
config.Beach_Grass_WaFFLE.name: Grass patches
config.Beach_Grass_WaFFLE.description: Add small grass patches to all beaches besides the dead one. Will cause grass to naturally grow each year.
config.Beach_Bridge_WaFFLE.name: Beach bridges type
config.Beach_Bridge_WaFFLE.description: Either use small wooden bridges or natural sand step on the beach. Beware that the sand steps will prevent you from laying path tiles over them, which may hinder mods relying on said tiles to work (like Automate).
config.Spa_WaFFLE.name: Healing pond
config.Spa_WaFFLE.description: Place a healing pond south of the twin waterfalls.
config.Fountain_Decoration_WaFFLE.name: Decorated fountain area
config.Fountain_Decoration_WaFFLE.descri: Add a fountain and its decorated surroundings to the farm.
config.Waterfall_Silent_WaFFLE.name: Silent Waterfalls
config.Add_Cliffs_N_WaFFLE.name: Northern cliff
config.Add_Cliffs_N_WaFFLE.description: Add a cliff on the farmhouse main island.
config.Add_Cliffs_E_WaFFLE.name: Eastern cliffs
config.Add_Cliffs_E_WaFFLE.description: Add some cliffs to the south-eastern part of the map.
config.Add_Small_Ridges_N_WaFFLE.name: Northern ridge
config.Add_Small_Ridges_N_WaFFLE.descrip: Add a small ridge south of the farmhouse.
config.Add_Small_Ridges_E_WaFFLE.name: Eastern ridge
config.Add_Small_Ridges_E_WaFFLE.descrip: Add a small ridge near the south-eastern bridge.
config.Dense_Forest_Area_WaFFLE.name: Dense forested areas
config.Dense_Forest_Area_WaFFLE.descript: Add trees and a dense foliage above the tree stumps West and East of the farm.
config.Bridge_Deck_WaFFLE.name: Bridge deck
config.Bridge_Deck_WaFFLE.description: Select the type of bridge deck used on the farm (Standard will reuse the town's one).
config.Fences_WaFFLE.name: Fences amount
config.Fences_WaFFLE.description: Handle the amount of decorative fences that will be present on the farm.
config.Railway_Station_WaFFLE.name: Railway station
config.Railway_Station_WaFFLE.descriptio: Remove the currently unused railway station.
WFL_SFM.Boulder_SecretWoods_Shortcut: This massive boulder blocks your way. Behind it, a shadowy path appears to go deep into the woods...
WFL_SFM.Forest_Flamingo: The venerable Flamingo of the Forest gazes upon you silently, its worn eyes filled with the ancient wisdom of a forgotten age.
